Iran war live liveblog (Al Jazeera, Sat 8 Aug 2026)

IRGC spokesperson Sardar Mohebi: reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is conditional on the US "fully" accepting Iran's conditions — separate from and additional to any framework agreement reached with Oman.

Iran and Oman have agreed on a framework regarding the Strait of Hormuz, with final approval still pending from Tehran.

The United Arab Emirates expressed its "strong condemnation of the Iranian aggression" against an ADNOC tanker in the Strait of Hormuz (see dedicated ADNOC cache file).
